derived_invariants: no hidden conversational or project-source state remains canonical after bootstrap
emergent_motif: AUTHORING -> REVIEW -> (FEEDBACK -> AUTHORING)* -> GO -> AUTHORING(next goal)
finite_region: the complete bundle state admitted by the exact schemas and manifests
memory_state: CYCLE_STATE plus append-only transition and feedback ledgers
procedural_divergence_audit: every non-bootstrap state has exactly one admitted parent relation and every transition appends exactly one ledger row
procedural_flux: hash-bound transition and delta operations crossing the declared bundle boundary
scope_statement: The bundle cycle is an AFC implementation in the procedural control plane. It is an emergent workflow dynamics, not an automatic premise about the AOD scientific payload.

transition_kernel.note: Potential branches are an admissibility relation; only the selected, evidenced successor is materialized.

transition_ledger_bootstrap_rule: A legacy parent without a transition ledger may seed one hash-bound bootstrap row; every later successor must equal the parent ledger prefix plus exactly one row.
